summary: Implemented the engine-free CSV and NIfTI savers, the plot_2d_or_3d_image plotting function, the thin ignite handler adapters, the NIfTI writer dtype default change, the in-repo caller renames, and the five listed test files. Nothing was run and nothing was committed, per instructions. Residual risks: the pinned ignite 0.3.0 signature check of the bound _finalize wrapper is unverified; the segmentation examples now write model-output dtype because the default changed to None; Sphinx docs in docs/source were not updated for the two new modules.
